description: [Ncloud Storage] Set the CORS configuration of a Ncloud Storage bucket (PUT /?cors). Replaces the whole configuration. Up to 100 rules; each needs at least one AllowedOrigin and one AllowedMethod; one '*' wildcard per origin/header item; ExposeHeader does not allow wildcards.

bucketName.description: Name of the bucket to set CORS configuration for

corsRules.description: CORS rules to apply to the bucket

allowedMethods.description: HTTP methods allowed for cross-origin requests

allowedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to make cross-origin requests (e.g. 'https://example.com' or '*')

exposeHeaders.description: Response headers exposed to the browser (e.g. 'ETag', 'x-amz-request-id'); no wildcard

id.description: Optional rule ID (≤ 255 chars, unique). Auto-generated when omitted

maxAgeSeconds.description: Seconds the browser may cache the preflight response (e.g. 3600)

name: ncloud_ncs_put_bucket_cors
